description: The main working tree contains one current state only. When implementation, data, design, academic context, source metadata, or question blueprints change, the current artifact is updated or replaced directly and superseded artifacts are removed instead of keeping old/new, legacy, backup, or versioned copies. AI structures Lecture content into semantic question blueprints during automation/build time, and the shared runtime engine persistently deduplicates by learning objective/relation rather than serial number, wording, option order, pair order, or distractor order.
